## Description

Helper functions to combine multiparameter multiple imputation estimates
in R [@RCoreTeam-2026]:
a multivariate version of Rubin's rules [@Rubin-1987]
and the adjustment proposed by @Li-Raghunathan-Rubin-1991.
Models are fitted on the imputed data sets
from `mice`, `Amelia`, or `norm2`
(`MIFit()`) and pooled with `MICombine()`.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `miHelper` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ijapesigan/miHelper) with:

```r
if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/miHelper")
```

## Example

```{r}
library(package = "miHelper")
fit <- stats::lm(
  formula = Temp ~ .,
  data = datasets::airquality
)
M <- 5
```

Fit the model on each imputed data set
and combine the estimates.
The data sets are imputed with `mice` (`fun = "mice"`),
`Amelia` (`fun = "amelia"`),
or `norm2` (`fun = "mcmcNorm"`).

```{r}
set.seed(seed = 42)
mifit <- MIFit(
  x = datasets::airquality,
  fit = fit,
  fun = "mice",
  M = M
)
MICombine(object = mifit)$est
```

Use the adjustment of Li, Raghunathan, and Rubin (1991).

```{r}
MICombine(
  object = mifit,
  adj = TRUE
)$total_adj
```
